server.additional_regressions: Timed actions are not repeated; event-specific checks remain; existing artwork is preserved; inferred camera fields cannot override structural policy. Admission commits share the ingestion lock, release it during model I/O, recheck cancellation, and avoid repeated Running-state writes. Static presentation preserves the authored composition mode; closing holds prefer the actual frozen image dependency and fail closed when it is missing. Opening-frame prefixes use structural framing before legacy camera prose; an unplanned scene no longer invents a shot-index crop. Placed cue audio retains its shot, enabling the existing one-layer replacement query to remove earlier effects instead of stacking them. Composed outputs use the existing bounded persistence retry after expensive processing, recheck cancellation, and reuse immutable outputs; unchanged task summaries do not write again. Late finishing workers cannot revive Cancelled state.
